purpose: Teach: 小笠原/手塚/工藤/テキサス/バスク/ヤクザ/弥生/ロッテ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが小笠原諸島の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a picture book about the Ogasawara Islands.
lines.style: Warm, slightly formal announcement. Gentle pacing. Speaking as though sharing something special she's learned. A hint of smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと手塚治虫の漫画読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a Tezuka Osamu manga together!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick tempo. Word tumbling out before he can stop himself. Small-child certainty that this is the best thing to report.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが工藤さんというお友達のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me about his friend Kudo.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Slightly slower than before. Testing whether Sho's heard this story. A note of gentle curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとテキサスの地図見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a map of Texas!
lines.style: Unguarded delight. Slightly higher pitch. Words pushing forward with genuine amazement that maps exist and he got to see one.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバスク地方の料理を作って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to make Basque food for us.
lines.style: Soft announcement. Measured pacing. A note of care in the voice — she's sharing something she wants him to anticipate with pleasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ヤクザって怖いから近づかないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, yakuza are scary, so I'm not going near them.
lines.style: Serious, matter-of-fact. No hesitation in the delivery. A small boy stating something he's certain about. Quiet conviction, not seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが弥生時代の遺跡に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's taking you to see the Yayoi period ruins.
lines.style: Gentle excitement held steady. Warm announcement. Pacing gives the words room to settle. Speaking as though this is something remarkable Sho will remember.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとロッテの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched a Lotte game together!
lines.style: Bright, satisfied conclusion. Quick tempo with a soft landing. The joy of something simple and complete. A small person's contentment with a perfect afternoon.
